title: Contumelious

inlines.v: CONTUMELIOUS, adjective [Latin See Contumely.] 1. Haughtily reproachful; contemptuous; insolent; rude and sarcastic; as contumelious language. 2. Haughty and contemptuous; disposed to utter reproach, or to insult; insolent; proudly rude; as a contumelious person. 3. Reproachful; shameful; ignominious.
